quarterly_data.signal: Baby-COMET phase 3 (released June 30, 2026): Nexviazyme met its primary endpoint (treatment-naive infants six months and younger with infantile-onset Pompe disease alive and free of invasive ventilation at 52 weeks) and all secondary endpoints, including alive and free of invasive ventilation at 12 and 18 months of age. Seventeen participants received 40 mg/kg every other week; there were no serious treatment-related treatment-emergent adverse events, deaths or discontinuations, and infusion-associated reactions occurred in 29.4% of participants. The data will support a US label-extension submission anticipated in the second half of 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: primary and all secondary endpoints met; 17 participants; US submission anticipated in the second half of 2026
